{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the dtype of the 'revenue' column
revenue_dtype = sales_df['revenue'].dtype

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df_cleaned = sales_df.copy()
df_cleaned['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df_cleaned['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric values after conversion
non_numeric_revenue = df_cleaned[df_cleaned['revenue'].isna()]

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df_cleaned[df_cleaned['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = df_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the results
revenue_dtype, non_numeric_revenue.shape[0], mean_revenue_completed"}
